events.title: v0.2.3 Update – Profiles, Start, Balance!
events.summary: Hello, everyone!Zodiac Lottery has been updated to v0.2.3This update introduces a new profile system and a redesigned game start screen. We've also reviewed several language translations and made balance adjustments to improve the overall gameplay experience.Check out the details below!🛠️Update NotesProfile SelectionYou can now create and select multiple profiles.Each profile saves its stage progress separately.Start a fresh adventure with a new profile whenever you like!New Game Start ScreenAdd

events.title: v0.2.0 Update
events.summary: v0.2.0New relics have been added, bringing the total to 99.Stages have been introduced, allowing you to progress from easier levels onward.Endless Mode has been added.A friendly little mouse has appeared.*Some translations may sound a little awkward. If you notice anything strange, please let us know!**Feedback on the game is always welcome. Feel free to share it with us on Discord.THANK YOU!!

events.title: v0.1.5 Update
